stats.vpipTooltip: VPIP (Voluntarily Put In Pot): % of hands where player voluntarily put chips in the pot
stats.pfrTooltip: PFR (Pre-Flop Raise): % of hands where player raised pre-flop
stats.threeBetTooltip: 3Bet: % of hands where player re-raised an opponent's raise
stats.afTooltip: AF (Aggression Factor): ratio of aggressive actions (bet/raise) to passive actions (call)

style.tagTooltip: Tight Aggressive: plays few hands but bets strongly when in
style.lagTooltip: Loose Aggressive: plays many hands and bets strongly
style.tpTooltip: Tight Passive: plays few hands, mostly calls
style.lpTooltip: Loose Passive: plays many hands but rarely raises

settings.tournamentNote: Tournament settings apply from the next reset

tutorial.communityCards: Community cards shared by all players. Five cards are revealed progressively.
tutorial.playerHand: Your hole cards (2 cards). Combine with community cards to make the best 5-card hand.
tutorial.actionButtons: Choose your action: Bet, Call, Raise, Fold, or All In.
tutorial.potDisplay: Shows the current pot size and blind levels.
tutorial.cpuArea: CPU opponent information. Cards are revealed at showdown.
tutorial.learningMode: Learning mode shows equity and pot odds to help your decisions.
tutorial.resetButton: Press the reset button to start a new game.
